lastTask: Implement Byte 13b-c3 musical event buffer flush to persistence

projectState.summary: Byte 13b-c3 wires high-frequency musical events to persistence without doing I/O in the audio callback. `handleMusicalEvent` only enqueues the emitted event plus a tonal-context snapshot into the source buffer. A setup-time interval drains up to 64 sources, builds schema-v1 `musical.event_recorded` payloads, and hands deterministic ids (`musical-<sessionId>-<sourceEventId>`) to the existing retained/idempotent persistence queue. The source buffer flushes on stop/pagehide/HMR, the Session inspector shows event-buffer pending/enqueued/dropped/last-flush state, and smoke verifies persisted musical rows are ordered by source event id with grid/performed payloads.
